articles.title: How the King and Queen spent their second day in the US
articles.summary: King Charles III and Queen Camilla continued their state visit in Washington D.C., engaging with President Trump's cabinet members. The King delivered a notable speech to both houses of the US Congress, underscoring the enduring historical ties and strengthening diplomatic relations between the United States and the United Kingdom, crucial for global stability.

articles.title: tiny-metal-nn added to PyPI
articles.summary: tiny-metal-nn (tmnn) is a new C++ library enabling efficient neural-field training and inference on Apple GPUs. Inspired by the CUDA-based tiny-cuda-nn, tmnn is Metal-native, optimizing AI computations for Apple hardware. This innovation enhances machine learning model deployment and efficiency, critical for advanced data processing and simulations, signifying progress in specialized computing for AI applications.
